notes: Pack and riding animals and vehicles (Plan 4, B1). capacity is the kg of cargo each carries, against 20 kg per member at STR 10; a ridden horse's capacity is what it carries besides its rider. waterPerDay is in days of a member's water (2 kg each), doubled in the desert. Owned animals cost no upkeep (designer call 2026-11-13: mounts have no upkeep and a higher price instead; pack animals and vehicles follow the same rule, since their keep was coin for fodder and stabling, not the party's food), so price is the whole cost of owning one: raised from 5/8/50/50/75/15/35 gp to make each a real decision for a 10–50 gp party. Only riding animals are hired (hirePerDay, per member, for a journey to a settlement). Riding speed is 2× (1.25× in mountains, marsh and jungle, A4). maxPathDanger keeps horses and camels off rough paths to sites. Transport rules (designer calls 2026-11-13): carts and wagons are `vehicle` (each working one adds VEHICLE_HOSTILE, +10%, to the hostile share: the 'cargo vehicles' part of the road preview) and `slow` (while the party has one, the brisk and forced paces are unavailable); they may now leave the roads (roadsOnly dropped), with no terrain penalty. The wagon is several times the cart's price (150 against 30 gp) for more kg per gp (1500 kg: 10 kg/gp against the cart's 6.7; with the draft horse that pulls it, 1620 kg for 230 gp, 7.0 kg/gp, against the cart and mule's 290 kg for 50 gp, 5.8 kg/gp). The camel is 100 gp and carries 120 kg (was 90 gp, 150 kg); `desertWater`: in the desert each owned camel cuts the living members' water by 12.5% (CAMEL_DESERT_WATER_SAVING), up to 50% with four (CAMEL_DESERT_WATER_MAX), in whole units a day rounded to the nearest (designer refinement 2026-11-13). INTERPRETATION for the designer: 'only the first animal would remove fast speeds, but not increase visibility' is read as the donkey, the cheapest pack animal, being `slow` (no brisk or forced pace) but not a `vehicle` (no added hostility). To flip it, remove `slow` from the donkey. The flying carpet (designer call 2026-11-13; its rules are proposals for the designer to confirm): sold only by animals and vehicle services in desert towns and cities (soldIn: desert, size Town or larger) for 2500 gp. It `flies` when it is the party's only animal (owned or hired: no mule or horse keeps up; with other animals it is rolled up and carries nothing). Flying, it carries the whole party and a fixed 100 kg of cargo whatever the members' strength, at 2x speed on any terrain (no rough-terrain cap; the terrain's own km a day, the pace, the load and exhaustion still apply), on any path to a site, and drinks nothing; no mounts are for hire then. Proposed: every pace stays open (it isn't slow), and it adds no hostility (it is not a vehicle: high above the road it is seen but hard to reach). It can't be stolen, and pays a sea fare like any animal.
